name: Client MeshRef Leak Fix
description: Client-only. When Vintage Story garbage-collects an undisposed MeshRef, this actually frees the OpenGL VAO on the render thread instead of leaking VRAM. Stops the session-long FPS slide and hitching from MeshRef leaks (skeps, handbook, HD meshes, GUI leftovers). 1.1.4: outer try/catch on Harmony Finalize prefix and ExecuteMainThreadTasks drain postfix so a dispose failure cannot crash the client. Adaptive drain. Metrics off render thread. DLL-only zip. No GC.Collect, no key injection.
